name: core.openwop.workflows.channel-turn
description: The channel agent-turn workflow (ADR 0154 Phase 4), migrated off the in-tree `registerWorkflow(DEF)` pin site (ADR 0703 / PIN_SITE_QUARANTINE drain — instance #3 of the SCWF-1 class, after assistant and scheduled-agent-chats). chainId keeps the original workflowId so every dispatch and run stamp keeps resolving.

chains.label: Channel agent turn
chains.description: Runs the addressed agent member against the channel post and appends the reply as an assistant turn in that channel. System-fired: the credential is the host-owned managed key, never BYOK, because a channel post has no acting user to hold one.

agentId.description: The addressed agent member to run.

task.description: The channel post the agent responds to.

credentialRef.description: The host-owned managed credential (system-fired — no BYOK).

conversationId.description: The channel the reply posts into.
